findings.entity: Red apple / umbrella shaft / woman's right hand
findings.description: At 0:04 the apple is clearly gripped in her right hand. At 0:06 the apple sits directly on top of the umbrella shaft above her left fist, appearing skewered/merged with the pole, while her right hand is open with fingers spread and not holding anything. No transfer motion is shown; by 0:08 the apple is in her other hand.

In the profile shot at 0:08 the umbrella shaft descends from the canopy and terminates at her upper chest with no hand gripping it. Her near (left) hand holds the apple and her far (right) hand is not in contact with the pole, so the open umbrella floats unsupported.
